Notre Dame defeats Villanova in Rome basketball season opener

The Notre Dame Fighting Irish defeated the Villanova Wildcats 74-72 in their college basketball season opener, which took place in Rome. Pope Leo met with both the Villanova and Notre Dame basketball teams at the Vatican.
